questions.question: Which short-range IoT wireless technology needs a distance of 4 cm or less to start a connection?
questions.explanation: Near-Field Communication (NFC) needs a distance of 4 cm or less to start a connection. Bluetooth has a range of about 10 metres.

questions.question: In asymmetric-key cryptography, which key does the receiver use to decrypt the message?
questions.explanation: In asymmetric encryption the sender uses the public key and the receiver uses the private key, which is kept secret by the receiver. A single shared secret key belongs to symmetric cryptography.

questions.question: In the five-layer IoT protocol stack, 6LoWPAN (IPv6 over Low-Power Wireless Personal Area Networks) belongs to which layer?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer protocols of the IoT stack are IPv6 and 6LoWPAN. IEEE 802.15.4 and LPWAN sit at the Data Link Layer, and TCP and UDP at the Transport Layer.

questions.question: In a priority queue, how are elements that have the same priority arranged?
questions.explanation: A priority queue arranges elements by priority, and elements with the same priority are arranged according to the FIFO principle.

questions.question: Which Windows power mode is meant for a computer that will not be used for a long time?
questions.explanation: Hibernate mode is used when the computer will not be used for a long time, while Sleep mode is used for a short break.

questions.question: Which of the following Python data types is mutable?
questions.explanation: In Python, list, set and dictionary are mutable, while int, tuple and string are immutable.

questions.question: Who is known as the father of software engineering?
questions.explanation: Watts S. Humphrey is called the father of software engineering. Mills is associated with the Cleanroom philosophy.

questions.concept: Halting states of a Turing machine
questions.question: The halting state of a Turing machine, where it stops processing input, corresponds to which outcomes?
questions.explanation: The halting state of a Turing machine is Accept or Reject: Accept means the computation succeeded and Reject means it was unsuccessful.

questions.question:
What is the output of the following Python code?

list1 = [1, 2, 'a', 'c', [6, 7, 8], 4, 9]
print(len(list1), list1[4][1])
questions.explanation: The nested list [6, 7, 8] counts as one element, so len(list1) is 7. list1[4] is [6, 7, 8] and index 1 of it is 7.

questions.question: Which of the following is a multimedia authoring system software tool?
questions.explanation: Multimedia authoring tools include Macromedia/Adobe Flash, Director, Authorware and Quest. Illustrator and CorelDraw are vector image software, and Photoshop is pixel-based image software.

questions.question: A network that is shared between two companies is called:
questions.explanation: By access, the Internet is open to all, an intranet is only for employees, and an extranet is between two companies.

questions.question:
What is the output of the following Python code?

x = 100
y = 50
print(x and y)
questions.explanation: The and operator returns y when x is truthy. Since 100 is truthy, x and y gives 50.

questions.concept: Maximum table name length in PostgreSQL
questions.question: What is the maximum length of a table name in PostgreSQL as per the syllabus?
questions.explanation: The maximum length of a table name in PostgreSQL is given as 64 characters.

questions.concept: Alpha, beta, regression and black-box testing
questions.question: Which of the following statements about software testing are correct? (Select all that apply)

options.A: Beta testing is done by the development team at the developer's site.
options.B: Alpha testing is performed at the developer's end.
options.C: In black-box testing, the internal code is visible to the tester.
options.D: Regression testing reruns previous test cases after maintenance.

questions.explanation: Alpha testing happens at the developer's end, and regression testing reruns earlier test cases after maintenance. Beta testing is done at the client end, and in black-box testing the internal design is not considered.

questions.question: Which of the following is an SQL scalar function rather than an aggregate function?
questions.explanation: MID() extracts characters from a text field and is a scalar function. FIRST(), LAST() and COUNT() return a single value from a column and are aggregate functions.

questions.question: Which of the following processors is an example of CISC architecture?
questions.explanation: Intel 386/486 and the Pentium family are CISC examples. DEC Alpha and MC88100 are RISC, and IA-64 is EPIC.

questions.question: A person who attempts to break ciphertext in order to obtain the original plaintext is called a:
questions.explanation: A cryptanalyst attempts to break ciphertext to recover the original plaintext.

questions.question: A DHCP client sends a request to the DHCP server. Which port number does the server use?
questions.explanation: DHCP server uses port 67 (client sends to server) and DHCP client uses port 68 (server sends to client). Port 53 is DNS and 110 is POP3.

questions.question: How is C++ classified in terms of object orientation?
questions.explanation: C++ is a semi-object-oriented programming language. Smalltalk is the 100% (pure) object-oriented language.

questions.concept: Null pointer count in linked lists
questions.question: Which type of linked list contains exactly two null pointers?
questions.explanation: A doubly linked list has two null pointers (start and end). A singly linked list has one, and a circular linked list has none because the last node points back to the head.

questions.concept: inline keyword copies body to call site
questions.question: In C++, which keyword creates a function whose body is copied to the location of the function call at compile time?
questions.explanation: An inline function, created with the inline keyword, has its body copied to the call location at compile time, which may make execution faster.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a single-user, single-tasking operating system?
questions.explanation: MS-DOS is single-user, single-tasking. Windows and macOS are single-user multi-tasking, Windows Server is multi-user multi-tasking, and Windows 2000 is a client/server OS.

questions.question: Which of the four primary machines in TOC is described as a type of Turing machine with limited memory?
questions.explanation: A linear bounded automaton is a Turing machine with limited memory. Finite automata recognize regular languages and pushdown automata recognize context-free languages.

questions.question: The Intel 8086 microprocessor belongs to which generation and bit width?
questions.explanation: 3rd generation microprocessors are 16-bit (8086, 8088, 80186, 80188, 80286). The 8-bit 2nd generation includes 8008, 8080 and 8085.
